subject: Franska
title: Reading comprehension: a longer text
sourceSummary: A connected text about a trip, with questions that require linking several parts of the text together.

questions.prompt:
Read the text: "L'été dernier, ma famille et moi sommes allés au Maroc pendant deux semaines. Nous avons visité les marchés de Marrakech et goûté à la cuisine locale, comme le couscous et les tajines. Il a fait très chaud tous les jours, mais il n'a pas plu une seule fois."

When did the family take the trip?
questions.opener: Look for the time expression in the first sentence.

questions.prompt: Same text. How long were they in Morocco?
questions.opener: "Pendant deux semaines" — look for the length of time.

questions.prompt: Same text. What did they visit?
questions.explanation: "Nous avons visité les marchés de Marrakech" means "we visited the markets in Marrakech".

questions.prompt: Same text. What was the weather like during the trip?
questions.opener: Look for the last sentence about the weather.
questions.explanation: "Il a fait très chaud tous les jours, mais il n'a pas plu une seule fois" means "it was very hot every day, but it didn't rain a single time".

questions.prompt:
Continuation: "Ce que j'ai préféré, c'était la nourriture. Le tajine est un plat cuit lentement avec de la viande et des légumes — ça semble simple, mais c'est délicieux !"

What did the writer like best about the trip?
questions.opener: "Ce que j'ai préféré" — what is the sentence about?
questions.explanation: "Ce que j'ai préféré, c'était la nourriture" means "what I liked best was the food".

questions.prompt: Same text. Which two main ingredients are mentioned in "tajine"? Answer in English.
questions.opener: Look for "avec de la viande et des...".

questions.prompt: Write a short French sentence (4–6 words) that answers: "Quel temps a-t-il fait pendant le voyage ?" (What was the weather like during the trip?)
questions.opener: Combine the information about heat and the lack of rain.
questions.answer: Il a fait chaud et il n'a pas plu.
steps: Find the weather information in the text: "Il a fait très chaud tous les jours" and "il n'a pas plu une seule fois".
Shorten it to the essentials: "il a fait chaud" (it was hot) and "il n'a pas plu" (it didn't rain).
Put it together: "Il a fait chaud et il n'a pas plu." (It was hot and it didn't rain.)

questions.prompt: Which strategies help you understand a longer French text with several connected sentences?
questions.opener: Linking information from different parts of the text.
questions.answer: Read the whole text once without stopping at unknown words, to get the big picture. Look for time markers (l'été dernier, pendant deux semaines) to understand WHEN something happened. Look for passé composé forms (sommes allés, avons visité, a fait, a plu) to understand WHAT happened. Connect pronouns and references: "ce que j'ai préféré" refers back to the whole experience. Guess new words from context — "délicieux" can be guessed (a positive judgment about food) even without having seen the word before.

questions.prompt:
Read the text: "Quand j'avais douze ans, ma famille a déménagé dans une autre ville. Au début, mes anciens amis me manquaient beaucoup, mais peu à peu je me suis fait de nouveaux amis à l'école. Maintenant, cinq ans plus tard, je ne regrette rien."

How old was the person when the family moved?
questions.opener: Look for the time expression in the first sentence.
questions.explanation: "Quand j'avais douze ans" means "when I was twelve years old", indicating the person's age at the time of the move.

questions.prompt: Same text. How did the person feel at first?
questions.opener: The second sentence describes the feelings at the start.
choices: Missed their old friends a lot
Wanted to move back right away
questions.explanation: "Mes anciens amis me manquaient beaucoup" means "I missed my old friends a lot".

questions.prompt: Same text. How does the person feel now, according to the text?
questions.opener: The last sentence sums up how the person feels today.
choices: Still misses their old city a lot
questions.explanation: "Je ne regrette rien" means "I don't regret anything".

questions.prompt:
New text: "Ma meilleure amie et moi nous sommes rencontrées le premier jour de collège. Au début, nous n'avons pas beaucoup parlé, mais pendant le déjeuner, nous avons commencé à parler de musique et découvert que nous aimions le même groupe. Depuis, nous sommes inséparables."

When did the two friends meet?
questions.opener: Read the new text about two friends.
choices: On the first day of school
questions.explanation: "Nous sommes rencontrées le premier jour de collège" means "we met on the first day of school".

questions.prompt: Same text. What did they start talking about at lunch?
questions.opener: The middle of the text describes what they talked about.
questions.explanation: "Nous avons commencé à parler de musique" means "we started talking about music".

questions.prompt: Same text. What did they discover they had in common?
questions.opener: The text describes a shared discovery.
choices: They live on the same street
They go to the same dance class
questions.explanation: "Nous avons découvert que nous aimions le même groupe" means "we discovered we like the same band".

questions.prompt: Same text. How does the person describe their current friendship?
questions.opener: The last sentence describes their friendship today.
choices: They see each other once a year
